name: Fake media preview leading to a verification page
description: A teaser message with a fake platform media preview lures a click to a fake 'verification' page that harvests the account.

source_references.quote: The link leads to a fake Facebook viewer that prompts users to 'verify' to see the content.

explanation.plain: A message with a photo/video preview asked you to tap and 'verify' to see it. The preview is fake and the verify page steals your account. Do not tap.
explanation.technical: Fake preview / teaser bait (identity) with a verification prompt (credential-action). Matches CERT-In GhostPairing wording.
verification_steps: Do not tap 'verify' pages reached from a message preview.
Open the real app directly to check any notification.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
